design_philosophy.aesthetic: Tactical DCC Industrial — Blender-meets-Unreal Engine 5 Dark Workspace
design_philosophy.theme: Dark Charcoal / Slate / Technical Gunmetal with Blender Kinetic Amber-Orange accents and Unreal Electric Cyan highlights
design_philosophy.emotional_tone: Precise, surgical, authoritative 3D technical tooling for game animators and technical artists
core_principles: Zero visual fluff: maximum contrast and screen real-estate for the 3D viewport
Immediate anatomical feedback with distinct 3D landmark color standards
Exact Unreal Engine 5 Quinn mannequin bone hierarchy fidelity (root, pelvis, spine_01..05, clavicles, twists, IK roots, 5 fingers per hand)
Continuous tactile workflow navigation (stages 1 to 6) anchored at the bottom with shortcut-ready tactile ergonomics

rules: Banned fonts: Inter, Roboto, Open Sans for headings
All bone names (e.g. spine_03, upperarm_twist_01_l, ik_hand_root) MUST be rendered in JetBrains Mono font with lowercase formatting matching UE5 specs
Headings must use tight tracking and uppercase industrial styling

Clean white humanoid head and torso wireframe topology reference
Unreal Engine 5 badge icon style graphics

features: Three.js Canvas with WebGLRenderer, ACESFilmicToneMapping, antialias
Infinite dual-frequency grid floor with subtle axis markers (X red, Z blue)
Mesh renderer supporting procedurally generated humanoid dummy + user loaded GLB/GLTF/OBJ/FBX geometries
Custom Transform Gizmo integration for dragging landmark spheres in 3D space
Dynamic Camera Views (Front, Right, Top, Back, Isometric Perspective, True Orthographic)
Symmetry indicator plane (semi-transparent X=0 plane togglable)
Bone segment visualizer (Lines and 3D octahedrons connecting fitted bones according to Quinn hierarchy)
Step-by-step active placement cursor mode
Interactive landmark rows with status pills: [PLACED, PENDING, ACTIVE]
Symmetry mirror trigger (copies Left markers to Right with inverted X coordinate)
Undo / Redo stack tracker with hotkey listener (Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y)
Numerical coordinate editors with fine stepper [+/- 0.01m]
Collapsible tree view matching exact UE5 SKM_Quinn bone tree
Search filter for instant bone lookup (e.g. twist, ik, spine, thumb)
Bone details inspector showing parent, children, roll angle, and computed transform position
JSON Skeleton Schema importer/uploader modal with schema validation
Named Project selector, Create New Project, and Save/Load to MongoDB via FastAPI backend
Drag & Drop 3D mesh file uploader supporting GLB, GLTF, FBX, OBJ with file validation
Mesh diagnostic summary: Polygon count, bounds in meters, vertex normal health
One-click sample character loader for instantaneous testing without needing an external FBX file
6 Interactive breadcrumb stages with status indicators (Completed, In Progress, Ready)
Stage progression gating with clear validation requirements
Next Step primary action button with contextual instructions
Quick export launcher for UE5 ready asset package

interactive_and_test_attributes.rule: Every button, input, toggle, select, and key metric MUST have an explicit data-testid attribute in kebab-case

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Read this entire design_guidelines.json carefully before writing code.
2. All files are standard JavaScript (.js / .jsx), NOT .tsx. Never use TypeScript types or interfaces in the React files.
3. Set up Three.js with loaders (GLTFLoader, OBJLoader) and ensure OrbitControls and 3D landmark picking work reliably.
4. Use the exact UE5 Quinn bone hierarchy names specified in 'ue5_quinn_skeleton_specifications' - this is a core requirement of the user.
5. Provide a built-in sample character mesh (Quinn mannequin dummy) that renders immediately on launch so the user doesn't have to hunt for an FBX file to start testing.

6. Ensure the UI feels like a top-tier desktop DCC application: compact dark theme, dark charcoal panels (#16171b, #1e2025), crisp 1px borders (#2e323b), Blender-amber highlights (#ea580c / #f97316), and clear anatomical landmark color coding (white center, cyan left, red right, yellow fingers).
7. Include MongoDB persistence endpoints in the FastAPI backend (/api/projects, /api/projects/{id}) to save and reload landmark positions and project configurations.
8. Add Sonner toast notifications for actions like Landmark placed, Project saved, Symmetry mirrored, Skeleton fitted, and Export generated.
9. Strictly respect data-testid attributes on all interactive elements as cataloged in this specification.
